status_as_of_cutoff.note: Official SEPA records and Microsoft/Chelan PUD notices confirm phased construction, 2025 commissioning plans for the Malaga first data center, 2026 revised grading/staging review at 4770 Saturday Ave, and Douglas County SEPA review for East Wenatchee EAT06/EAT09. No official source verified full operation of the full portfolio.

capacity_mw.note: Baseline record had no verified capacity.

Washington Ecology SEPA record states the Malaga 105-acre site's conceptual switchyard ultimate buildout is to accommodate 360 MW load; Chelan PUD approved short-term supply up to 18 MW through December 2025 for commissioning. These are not verified energized IT capacity.

owner.note: Applicant/owner verified across Washington Ecology SEPA records for Chelan County and Douglas County.

actions.exact_result_status: SEPA record 202301103 for BP-230107 covers site preparation and phased construction of three approximately 250,000 sq. ft. Malaga data center buildings with supporting infrastructure, including Jumpoff Ridge Switchyard and transmission upgrades; conceptual switchyard design accommodates 360 MW load for the 105-acre site.
actions.access_caveat: SEPA/project-description record; not an occupancy or energized-capacity record.

actions.exact_result_status: Hearing minutes state staff presented CUP 23-145 water tanks and CUP 23-156 switchyard as meeting approval criteria; the record was closed after applicant testimony. The switchyard was described as single-use under the Microsoft agreement.
actions.access_caveat: Minutes corroborate local review for supporting infrastructure; final approval conditions are better documented in separate CUP final-decision PDFs.

actions.exact_result_status: SEPA record 202400382 for BPC-2023-074 covers two interconnected single-story East Wenatchee data center buildings totaling 250,531 sq. ft. on Microsoft-owned property at 875 Urban Industrial Way Building E & F.
actions.access_caveat: SEPA/project-description record; not an occupancy or energized-capacity record.

actions.exact_result_status: Chelan PUD commissioners approved contract terms to power Microsoft's Malaga campus; Microsoft planned to begin commissioning in August 2025, with short-term supply up to 18 MW of surplus hydropower through December 2025 and 2026-2040 power source not yet determined.
actions.access_caveat: Power contract/commissioning notice; does not prove full commercial operation or full buildout.

source_notes.note: Chelan County SEPA record for Malaga EAT12-13-14 campus, three approximately 250,000 sq. ft. buildings, supporting infrastructure, and 360 MW conceptual switchyard load.
Microsoft local project page states Malaga first-phase construction began June 2023, building work expected May 2024 through early 2026, and construction completion does not indicate operability.
Douglas County SEPA record for East Wenatchee EAT06/EAT09, two interconnected buildings totaling 250,531 sq. ft. at 875 Urban Industrial Way Building E & F.
Chelan PUD power contract for Malaga commissioning: up to 18 MW short-term supply through December 2025; 2026-2040 source not yet determined.
Revised Chelan County SEPA record for 4770 Saturday Ave staging/grading support work with 43.5-acre clearing/grading area and revised 2:1 shrubsteppe mitigation.

contradictions.description: Chelan County SEPA records for the 4770 Saturday Ave staging/grading action show the same proposal first with 1:1 mitigation/preservation of 13 acres and later as a revised ODNS with 2:1 mitigation/preservation of 26 acres. Treat the 2026-02-10 revised ODNS as current.

Official sources disclose a 360 MW conceptual switchyard/load accommodation for Malaga and an 18 MW short-term commissioning supply. Neither source states energized IT capacity or total portfolio capacity, and East Wenatchee MW remains unverified.
